in_marathi.name: Ishita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Women, Wife, Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishita is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘isha’ which means ‘goddess’ or ‘female form of the god’. This name is often associated with the goddess Shiva’s consort, Parvati, and symbolizes the ideal wife, the embodiment of love, fertility, and prosperity.
